info.title: Nhà Này Hơi Báo — Admin Content API
info.description: Phase A implemented source contract, not proof of production deployment. JWT is carried in HttpOnly AUTH_TOKEN cookie; browser cannot read it. Fetch a CSRF token with credentials from /api/v1/auth/csrf and send its header on POST/PUT/DELETE. All APIs require ADMIN and no-store responses. Publishing a content release to the public slot is included since 2026-10-28 (POST /content/releases/{release}/publish, permission releases:publish); Pages deployment, import, commerce and user administration remain outside this version.

post.summary: Promote a draft to the public content slot
post.description: Requires releases:publish (no author fallback). The draft must be DRAFT, match expectedVersion and contain at least one revision. The release currently holding current_slot=1 is archived first (it stays readable by id); the target then becomes PUBLISHED with a new publishedAt. Both releases increase version and both transitions are audited. Publishing empty content returns 409 RELEASE_EMPTY. This publishes content in the database, not a Pages deployment.
